[[File:Steel-Eye.png|thumb|right|150px|Steel-Eye's skull]].
'''Steel-Eye''' was a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who wrecked a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] after a career of raiding [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liners]]. Steel-Eye attempted to recover the salvage, even going so far as to researching marine life in order to bypass the native wildlife, but the shipwreck was still unsalvaged by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Steel-Eye's nickname came from the pirate's [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] [[Eye/Legends|eye]]. After the pirate's death, Steel-Eye's skull ended up on [[Slave Island]].
